scripts.text: ^FF0000[ Treasure Hunter Guild House ]^000000
Welcome to the Treasure Hunter's Guild House.
scripts.translation: 歡迎來到尋寶者公會會館。

scripts.text: Feel free to drop in and look around
scripts.translation: 歡迎進來參觀，

scripts.text: and feel free to become a member if you wish.
scripts.translation: 也歡迎你按意願加入公會。

scripts.text: For membership applications please talk to Keegan
scripts.translation: 如需申請入會，請和基根談談，

scripts.text: up the stairs and down the hall.
scripts.translation: 他在樓梯上去後的走廊裡。

scripts.text: [Ahlma]
scripts.translation: [阿爾瑪]

scripts.text: Welcome to The Treasure Hunter Guild.
scripts.translation: 歡迎來到尋寶者公會。

scripts.text: How may I help you?
scripts.translation: 有什麼可以幫你？

scripts.text: Save
scripts.translation: 儲存

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text: [Ahlma]
scripts.translation: [阿爾瑪]

scripts.text: Ok, saved. Thank you ~ See you soon~
scripts.translation: 好的，已經儲存。謝謝~回頭見~

scripts.text: [Ahlma]
scripts.translation: [阿爾瑪]

scripts.text: Well if you think you are safe, good on you.
scripts.translation: 如果你覺得自己安全，那就好。

scripts.text: Sorry, members only.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，這裡只對會員開放。

scripts.text: [Smile Gal]
scripts.translation: [微笑女孩]

scripts.text: Oh man...I am so sick of
scripts.translation: 天啊...我真受夠了

scripts.text: trading Mr. Smile masks for crap.
scripts.translation: 拿破爛來換微笑面具這件事。

scripts.text: You ask me for one and you'll find yourself 10 pounds lighter!
scripts.translation: 你要是敢向我要一個，我就讓你體重減輕十磅！

scripts.text: [Sharlet]
scripts.translation: [夏洛特]

scripts.text: Umm sorry I'm not gonna waste my time talking to you if you aren't even a member!
scripts.translation: 嗯，抱歉，如果你連會員都不是，我可不想浪費時間跟你說話！

scripts.text: How are you reading this???
scripts.translation: 你是怎麼讀到這段話的？？？

scripts.text: Well unless you are reading the code :)
scripts.translation: 除非你是在讀程式碼 :)

scripts.text: Ahh welcome fellow Treasure Hunter {0}.
scripts.translation: 啊，歡迎你這位尋寶者同伴，{0}。

scripts.text: Did you hear about that brave man that went into Glast Heim alone?! He must be crazy.
scripts.translation: 聽說有個勇士獨自闖進了葛拉斯特海姆？！他肯定瘋了。

scripts.text: {0} don't you have something better you could be doing? Like a quest.
scripts.translation: {0}，你就沒有更有意義的事可做嗎？比如做個任務。

scripts.text: [Sasha]
scripts.translation: [莎莎]

scripts.text: Umm sorry I'm not gonna waste my time talking to you if you aren't even a member!
scripts.translation: 嗯，抱歉，如果你連會員都不是，我可不想浪費時間跟你說話！

scripts.text: Ahh welcome fellow Treasure Hunter {0}.
scripts.translation: 啊，歡迎你這位尋寶者同伴，{0}。

scripts.text: Did you hear about that goat man running around in the trees?
scripts.translation: 你聽說過在樹林裡到處跑的山羊人嗎？

scripts.text: Apparently his name is Baphomet and he has been running around the Forest Maze out side of Prontera for quite some time now.
scripts.translation: 聽說他叫巴風特，在普隆德拉外面的森林迷宮裡已經跑了很久。

scripts.text: {0} don't you have something better you could be doing? Like a quest.
scripts.translation: {0}，你就沒有更有意義的事可做嗎？比如做個任務。
